name: Shiori
source:
Former court alchemist, the only daughter of the Kuriana family.

Although she works hard to restore the ruined house, her ability is not able to catch up and she seems to be spinning.
She has a lot of pride and she can be reckless, but her roots are kind.
While she is aiming for the dragon (Hop), she deepens her interaction with Oto.


"I did see a dragon enter this house. I can see it!"
